pdf_page_count fails when the supplied password does not authenticate the document

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    var pdf_bytes_bytes_threaded = std.Io.Threaded.init(std.heap.c_allocator, .{});
    defer pdf_bytes_bytes_threaded.deinit();
    const pdf_bytes_bytes_io = pdf_bytes_bytes_threaded.io();
    const pdf_bytes_bytes = try std.Io.Dir.cwd().readFileAlloc(pdf_bytes_bytes_io, "pdf/password_protected.pdf", std.heap.c_allocator, .unlimited);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(pdf_bytes_bytes);
    if (xberg.pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes_bytes, "xberg-test-fake-wrong-password-1879")) |_| {
        return error.TestUnexpectedResult;
    } else |err| { std.debug.print("call failed as expected: {s}\n", .{@errorName(err)}); }
}
```
